descriptions.zh: 本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en: This API is limited to 10 queries per second (QPS) for each user. If you exceed this limit, API calls are throttled, which can affect your business. Call this API within the specified limit.
